caption:
Your packaging is the only piece of your brand a customer is guaranteed to hold in their hands. The slides cover four truths about it: the box is the handshake, survival beats beauty, small touches near the hands pay best, and a parcel worth photographing is free marketing.

Try this once. Ship an order to a friend and open it together like strangers. You will find at least one thing to fix, and we want to hear what it was.

#OnlineSellingIndia #EcommerceIndia #PackagingDesign #SmallBusinessIndia #BrandBuilding
